turns.text: Let me know if you need any help, okay?
turns.zh: 需要帮忙的话跟我说一声，好吗？

turns.text: Has anyone seen the updated database schema?
turns.zh: 有人见过更新后的数据库 schema 吗？

turns.text: I thought the DBA team was supposed to send it over.
turns.zh: 我以为 DBA 团队会把它发过来呢。

turns.text: I think Mark mentioned something about that in the team chat this morning.
turns.zh: 我记得 Mark 今天早上在团队聊天里提过这事儿。
